lines.zh: 我贴着雪地走，肚子快擦到地面。
lines.en: I hug the snow, belly almost dragging.

lines.zh: 短腿走得不快，可我一直在走。
lines.en: Short legs. Not fast, but I do not stop.
My bushy tail sweeps the snow.
Each paw print is deeper than the last.

lines.zh: 我不走大路，专挑石头缝。
lines.en: I avoid open trails; I take the rocks.
My nose roots through the snow.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，像块会动的肉。
lines.en: I walk heavy, like meat on the move.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着一点咔的响。
lines.en: Every step cracks faintly.
Snow whitens my back.
I skirt the ice. No chances.
I creep toward the noise.
I push a branch aside.
Every so often I look back.

lines.zh: 小个子，可我的骨头很硬。
lines.en: Small, but my bones are hard.

lines.zh: 我一路走过去，雪都翻起来。
lines.en: I plough along, snow turning over.
I crouch in the snow and stretch.
My teeth keep grinding.
I sniff my own paws.
Prey is not far from here.
I curl into a ball.
The wind is strong. I do not mind.
I bite a piece of frozen meat.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着雪面的一个洞。
lines.en: My eyes fix on a hole in the snow.
I stand and shake off the snow.
My claws can break frozen ground.
I listen under the snow.

lines.zh: 胸口还留着别的动物的毛。
lines.en: Another animal's fur still clings to my chest.
Short legs, but firmly planted.
My belly is hollow and rumbling.
I bare my teeth.
You are taller, but I am not afraid.
This frame is not to be trifled with.
I smell your meat.
I can bite through a deer's leg bone.
You climbed onto a rock.
Too cold for those clothes.
I rarely give way to anyone.
I would chew those boots open.
Glaring at me does nothing.
I do not roar. I lunge.

lines.zh: 寒地里我盯着你发抖的手。
lines.en: In the cold I watch your trembling hands.
I give a low growl.
I was bitten hard.
I roll away, half a beat late.
Blood drips on the snow.

lines.zh: 我会咬穿你的靴子报复。
lines.en: I will bite through your boots for this.
My hide is torn open.
I can still bite.
The pain makes my eyes narrow.
Raw venison. That is mine.
That meat. Bring it over.
I am not picky. The rarer the better.
Do not slice it. Give me the whole cut.
Put it down. I will take it myself.
I can swallow half a cut in one bite.
You are meat too, just less fresh.
Bring another. I will cache it.
A cut with bone is even better.
That smell of blood keeps me from sitting still.
One bite first, then I look at you.
I remember where I buried things.
Frozen meat is better cracked open.
You went into the snow.
My stance is low. I do not move.
Back off. My claws are forward.
You pressed on my back.
That bump changed nothing.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我的牙比个头凶。
lines.en: Out of my way; my teeth are fiercer than my size.
Hard footing in snow. Let us both give.
Your knee met my teeth.
In the snow I never take the long way around.
First, show me what you can bite open.
It is too cold this season.
I need to find my cache first.
Short legs, short life. No fuss.
You smell like a predator.
I must hold this stretch of snow.
Do not press against me.
That can wait.
I would rather find food.
Do not come near me.
I pick it up with my teeth.
Something dropped in the snow.
I bury it.
This meat, I cache first.
I dig the snow open looking for things.
I sniff it. Not food.
This little piece is mine.
There is more under the snow.
Do not dig up my cache.
You are on my ground.
I have lowered my head.
You cannot take this lunge.
You are on my snow.
You cannot run well in snow.
I never pass on a big meal.
The ice you stand on is cracking.
The prey is very close.
I load my hind legs.
The snow muffles me.
Each step back sinks you deeper.
I am measuring the distance.
My claws are in the snow.
Your legs are shaking.
I wait for an opening.
You just turned your head.
A little closer.
My claws rake across you.
My whole body slams in.
We churn the snow into the air.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
Short legs, quick spring.
That tore your trouser leg open.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶开你的膝盖。
lines.en: My shoulder jolts your knee.
You throw me off, and I lunge again.
I burrow out from under a snowbank.
First, shake off the snow.
This stretch is mine.
My nose moved first.
I lower myself and scan around.
The cold suits me.
Other prints have been here.
The snow sinks under me.
I tracked my way here.

lines.zh: 从石头上滚下去，摔得闷。
lines.en: I tumble off a rock with a thud.
I am no good in water.
An arrow sticks in my hind leg.
This light raises my fur.
Food is hard to find in winter.

lines.zh: 电打进雪里，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Current hits the snow and numbs me.
The snow is gone. Only black.
